title.th: กฎการควบคุมคาสิโน (การดำเนินการของหน่วยงาน) 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。其中 3 条为官方正文中标注的已废止条文存根（照录）。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Casino Control (Proceedings of Authority) Rules 2008 and shall come into operation on 1st July 2008.

heading.en: Time limit for decision‑making without meeting

text.en:
3. The Chairman may specify the time by which the members of the Authority have to sign or approve in writing a document containing a resolution.
[S 754/2019 wef 15/11/2019]

5. A motion for decision by the Authority lapses if ––
(a)the Chairman or the member presiding at a meeting of the Authority declines to exercise a casting vote in a case of an equality of votes; or
(b)in a case where the decision is to be passed in the manner described in section 31 of the Public Sector (Governance) Act 2018 (Act 5 of 2018) — the time specified by the Chairman under rule 3 ends before the resolution is passed.
[S 754/2019 wef 15/11/2019]
